items.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
               <jats:p>In this paper, the Laplace transform Variational Iteration Method (LVIM) is employed to obtain approximate analytical solutions of the linear and nonlinear partial differential equations. This method is a combined form of the Laplace transform method and the Variational Iteration Method. The proposed scheme, finds the solutions without any discretization or restrictive assumptions and is free from round-off errors and therefore, reduces the numerical computations to a great extent. Some illustrative examples are presented and the numerical results show that the solutions of the LVIM are in good agreement with the exact solution.</jats:p>
title: The Combined Laplace-Variational Iteration Method for Partial Differential Equations

title: Variational iteration method for solving partial differential equations with variable coefficients

items.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
               <jats:p>The two-dimensional integro-differential partial equations is one of the so difficult problems to be solved analytically and/or approximately, and therefore, a method that is efficient for solving such type of problems seems to be necessary. Therefore, in this paper, the iteration methods, which is so called the variational iteration method have been used to provide a solution to such type of problems approximately, in which the obtained results are very accurate in comparison with the exact solution for certain well selected examples which are constructed so that the exact solution exist. Main results of this work is to derive first the variational iteration formula and then analyzing analytically the error term and prove its convergence to zero as the number of iteration increases.</jats:p>
title: Iteration Variational Method for Solving Two-Dimensional Partial Integro-Differential Equations
